verdict.rationale: The repo explicitly lists Winget as an install method alongside Docker and pre-built binaries, showing at least one standard package manager is supported, but there's no mention of Homebrew/apt/conda or other mainstream package managers, and no community evidence of anyone actually using Winget to install it (community reports instead describe building from source or manually un-quarantining binaries). Missing for 10: broader package-manager coverage (e.g. Homebrew, apt), hands-on user reports confirming a smooth package-manager install experience.
